name: VHCB conservation grants (natural areas, local conservation and working forestlands)
summary: Vermont state grants to land trusts, municipalities and agencies to conserve natural areas with rare-species habitat, working forestland and locally significant natural and recreational land. Local grants cover acquisition and associated costs and need a one-third match.

amount.note: Local Conservation Grant Program, for recreational lands and natural areas, plus associated costs

steps: Call VHCB staff to discuss the project
Application of interest, for working forestlands only
VHCB staff review and property visit
Board decision at a board meeting

eligibility.rule: Is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, a Vermont municipality or a certain state agency
Shows long-term benefit to Vermonters through a lasting-effect mechanism
For local conservation, demonstrates municipal support from the project town

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are nonprofit housing and conservation organizations with federal 501(c)(3) status, Vermont municipalities, and certain state agencies.

geography.quote: VHCB funding is available for the conservation of Vermont forests owned and managed by private individuals or families.

access.quote: Eligible applicants are asked to call VHCB staff to discuss your project prior to completing an application.

amount.quote: grants of up to $150,000 plus associated costs are available for the purchase of recreational lands and natural areas

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants are required to provide one-third of total project costs from other sources

effort.quote: Eligible applicants are asked to call VHCB staff to discuss your project prior to completing an application.
To apply, first submit the application of interest.
Once this application is approved, applicants need to submit the full conservation application linked below.
VHCB conservation staff will review the application, visit the subject property, and compile a project summary for the Board.
The Board makes final funding decisions at regular board meetings.

eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants are nonprofit housing and conservation organizations with federal 501(c)(3) status, Vermont municipalities, and certain state agencies.
All applicants are required to show long-term benefit to Vermonters through deed restrictions or other mechanisms that ensure the funds provided will have a lasting effect.
must demonstrate municipal support from the town where the project is located

co_finance.quote: Applicants are required to provide one-third of total project costs from other sources
